# pve_vm_snapshot (Resource)

VM snapshot (name, description, RAM state, vmstate storage).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_vm_snapshot" "example" {
  node     = "pve1"
  snapname = "CHANGE_ME"
  vmid     = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `snapname` (String) The name of the snapshot.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A textual description or comment.
- `force` (Boolean) For removal from config file, even if removing disk snapshots fails.
- `vmstate` (Boolean) Save the vmstate

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node/vmid/snapname (also the `terraform import` format).
